_comment: WA1 APEXFORGE wave - compiled from docs/APEX_H22_BLUEPRINT.md (phases 0-4: G1/G4+C1 truth, C3 xref, C2 wire matrix, G2 recipe migration, ACRUX crucible). Base=master 782b2376. ARMED only on Joe word. Merge/push/flip remain Joe words per act. Own bus (apexforge/bus), own worktree prefix (wa1-*) - zero claim overlap with any live autorevise wave.

legs.name: Adversarial crucible for wave WA1 - audits TRUTH/XREF/WIRE/RECIPE verdicts, builds nothing
legs.note: APEXFORGE docs/APEX_H22_BLUEPRINT.md :: sec.7 contracts table + sec.10 failure classes - the crucible audits the two failure modes this blueprint is armor against. Blocked by design until the four builder receipts exist. Read-only. A green ACRUX receipt is a PRECONDITION for Joe's merge words, never a substitute for them.

legs.name: G2: migrate panel recipes off phantom APEX names + catalog-membership goalpost test - the phantom class becomes unshippable
legs.note: APEXFORGE docs/APEX_H22_BLUEPRINT.md :: sec.4 G2 - phantom-name migration + catalog-membership goalpost. The supersession map has existed in apex_probes.py since June; this leg executes it. Consume the fresh apex_truth catalog VIA THE BUS when TRUTH posts it; the supersession map in apex_probes.py is the migration guide either way. Pure-Python goalpost - no hou, no hython, stock pytest.

legs.name: G1+G4+C1: re-seed APEX truth surface under H22.0.400, author apex_basic autoresearch mission + probe kinds, extend version-agreement to the APEX catalog stamp
legs.note: APEXFORGE docs/APEX_H22_BLUEPRINT.md :: sec.4 G1/G4 + sec.5 C1 - re-stamp truth surface, apex_basic mission, catalog + port signatures. The H21.0.671 stamp on apex_probes.py is the stale-truth defect class DESIGN.md prosecuted. Probe execution is hython via .synapse/hytest.py shim discipline (skip != pass). Publish the catalog artifact path on the bus the moment it lands - WA1-WIRE and WA1-RECIPE consume it live.

legs.name: C2: wire-typing matrix + @/$ resolution table - W1 made mechanical, connects/coerces/rejects per ordered type pair
legs.note: APEXFORGE docs/APEX_H22_BLUEPRINT.md :: sec.5 C2 - wire-typing matrix, @/$ resolution, per-build regeneration. Depends on TRUTH's port-signature artifact for the type set - consume it VIA THE BUS when TRUTH posts it (dynamic handoff, do not wait for merge). Until it lands: scaffold the probe kind, the matrix mission, and tests against a fixture type set. hython execution through the hytest shim.

legs.name: C3: help-cache cross-reference referee - parse cached APEX node help, three-way diff runtime/docs/recipes, file phantom candidates
legs.note: APEXFORGE docs/APEX_H22_BLUEPRINT.md :: sec.5 C3 - help-cache cross-reference, three-way diff, phantom quarantine. Plain Python, no hou - parallel-safe with WA1-TRUTH by design. The cache is high-precision, low-recall (~18 APEX entries, lazily built): treat absence-from-cache as no-evidence, never as absence-from-product. Consume apex_truth via the bus when TRUTH posts it; until then build + test the parser against the cache alone.
